connector_policy: Connector matching is used only for the cross-sentence paragraph case. Same-sentence juxtaposition of restricted figures is forbidden outright, with no connector analysis, because a prohibition that depends on enumerating conjunctions can be evaded by choosing one nobody enumerated.
core_principle: supported claim A + supported claim B does NOT imply 'A therefore B', 'A although B', 'A contradicts B' or 'A is an exception to B' unless that relationship is itself supported by a source or an approved synthesis contract.
